ln_chat.lead: What goes into your own chat when a watched channel goes live.
ln_chat.name: Live notification - chat
ln_chat.no_sender_hint: Neither a bot account nor the channel itself is connected for writing – without a sender no chat message goes out.
ln_chat.only_when_live: Messages are only written while your own stream is running. A post into an empty chat is not lost – it sits there when the next stream starts and then reads like a message from just now.
ln_chat.perm.edit: may change the chat message template.
